title.zh: 长城：两千年的超级工程

clips.send: Han wall. After Emperor Wu’s armies pushed the Xiongnu back, Han built walls and beacon towers through the Hexi Corridor, past Yumen Pass, toward Lop Nur — guarding the new Silk Road.
clips.text: Han wall. After Emperor Wu’s armies pushed the Xiongnu back, Han built walls and beacon towers through the Hexi Corridor, past Yumen Pass, toward Lop Nur — guarding the new Silk Road.

clips.send: Liaodong. Today: eastern Liaoning. Liaodong means “east of the Liao River”. The Liaodong Peninsula reaches into the sea between the Bohai and the Yellow Sea.
clips.text: Liaodong. Today: eastern Liaoning. Liaodong means “east of the Liao River”. The Liaodong Peninsula reaches into the sea between the Bohai and the Yellow Sea.

clips.send: Lintao. Today: Min County, Gansu. The Qin wall ran about 5,000 km from Lintao in the west to Liaodong in the east.
clips.text: Lintao. Today: Min County, Gansu. The Qin wall ran about 5,000 km from Lintao in the west to Liaodong in the east.

clips.send: The land itself. Builders used mountains as part of the defence. Walls follow ridgelines, so attackers must climb a steep slope before they even reach the wall. In the game a ridge adds 2 m of “effective height”. Rivers and cliffs were used too: 2,232.5 km of the Ming line are natural barriers (2009 survey).

clips.send: Warring States walls. Before unification, states walled themselves in — against each other and against nomads from the north. Qi’s wall in Shandong is among the oldest; Chu built a “square wall”; Wei, Zhao, Yan and Qin built walls too.

clips.send: Badaling. The most-visited stretch of the Great Wall. The wall is about 7.8 m high and so wide on top that five horses could ride side by side.
clips.text: Badaling. The most-visited stretch of the Great Wall. The wall is about 7.8 m high and so wide on top that five horses could ride side by side.

clips.send: Great Wall. The First Emperor joined the walls of Qin, Zhao and Yan into a wall from Lintao to Liaodong. The pin marks Badaling near Beijing, one of the best-known sections.
clips.text: Great Wall. The First Emperor joined the walls of Qin, Zhao and Yan into a wall from Lintao to Liaodong. The pin marks Badaling near Beijing, one of the best-known sections.

clips.send: Jiayu Pass. This fort guarded a narrow gap between the Qilian Mountains and the Hei Mountains on the Silk Road.
clips.text: Jiayu Pass. This fort guarded a narrow gap between the Qilian Mountains and the Hei Mountains on the Silk Road.

clips.send: Jin border trenches. The Jurchen Jin dug long ditches backed by earth walls (界壕 jièháo, “border trenches”) across today’s Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang — against the rising Mongols.
clips.text: Jin border trenches. The Jurchen Jin dug long ditches backed by earth walls (界壕 jièháo, “border trenches”) across today’s Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang — against the rising Mongols.

clips.send: Yalu River. In October 1950 the Chinese People’s Volunteers crossed the Yalu at Dandong to resist US aggression and aid Korea.
clips.text: Yalu River. In October 1950 the Chinese People’s Volunteers crossed the Yalu at Dandong to resist US aggression and aid Korea.

clips.send: Northern Wei – Northern Qi – Sui. Later northern dynasties — Northern Wei, Northern Qi and Sui — kept adding walls in the north.
clips.text: Northern Wei – Northern Qi – Sui. Later northern dynasties — Northern Wei, Northern Qi and Sui — kept adding walls in the north.

clips.send: 空心敌台。骑在城墙上的小堡垒。抗倭名将戚继光调到北方后，主持在北京附近的长城上修建了一千多座空心敌台。士兵可以在里面驻守、储存武器，从窗口向两侧射击，形成交叉火力。

clips.send: 汉长城。汉武帝派兵打败匈奴后，汉朝在河西走廊修筑长城和烽燧，一直延伸到玉门关以西、罗布泊一带，保护了丝绸之路。
clips.text: 汉长城. 汉武帝派兵打败匈奴后，汉朝在河西走廊修筑长城和烽燧，一直延伸到玉门关以西、罗布泊一带，保护了丝绸之路。

clips.send: 北魏、北齐、隋长城。此后的北魏、北齐、隋等王朝也在北方修筑过长城。
clips.text: 北魏、北齐、隋长城. 此后的北魏、北齐、隋等王朝也在北方修筑过长城。

clips.send: 金界壕。女真族建立的金朝在今内蒙古、黑龙江一带挖掘界壕、修筑墙体，防御蒙古。
clips.text: 金界壕. 女真族建立的金朝在今内蒙古、黑龙江一带挖掘界壕、修筑墙体，防御蒙古。

clips.send: 明长城。明朝把蒙古势力赶回漠北后，用了约两百年时间修筑长城，东起鸭绿江畔的虎山，西至嘉峪关。2009年测得明长城全长8851.8千米（含天然险）。
clips.text: 明长城. 明朝把蒙古势力赶回漠北后，用了约两百年时间修筑长城，东起鸭绿江畔的虎山，西至嘉峪关。2009年测得明长城全长8851.8千米（含天然险）。

clips.send: 吐水嘴。把雨水排出墙外。石制的排水槽伸出墙外，雨水顺着它流走，不会顺墙渗进去。水是长城最大的“敌人”：渗水、结冰、冲刷都会毁坏城墙。

clips.send: 秦长城。秦始皇派蒙恬北击匈奴，把原来秦、赵、燕三国北部的长城连接起来并加以修筑，西起临洮（今甘肃岷县），东至辽东，号称“万里长城”。
clips.text: 秦长城. 秦始皇派蒙恬北击匈奴，把原来秦、赵、燕三国北部的长城连接起来并加以修筑，西起临洮（今甘肃岷县），东至辽东，号称“万里长城”。

clips.send: 战国长城。统一以前，各诸侯国为了互相防御和抵御北方游牧民族，纷纷修筑长城。山东的齐长城是现存最古老的长城之一；楚国修了“方城”；魏、赵、燕、秦也都修有长城。
